content: कृच्छ्र {%a.%} [<ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Uṇ. 2. 21</ls>] .²1 Causing trouble, painful; तथात्यजन्निमं देहं कृच्छ्राद् ग्राहाद्विमुत्त्यते <ls>Ms. 6. 78</ls>. .²2 Bad, miserable, evil. .²3 Wicked, sinful. .²4 Being in a difficult or painful situation. .{@-च्छ्रः, -च्छ्रम्@} .²1 A difficulty, trouble, hardship, misery, calamity, danger; कृच्छ्रं महत्तीर्णः <ls>R. 14. 6</ls>, <ls n="R.">13. 77</ls>. .²2 Bodily mortification, penance, expiation; <ls>Ms. 4. 222</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">5. 21</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">11. 106</ls>. .²3 Torment, torture. .²4 A particular kind of religious penance (प्राजापत्य); कृच्छ्राणि चीर्त्वा च ततो यथोक्तानि द्विजोत्तमैः <ls>Mb. 13. 10. 64</ls>. .{@-च्छ्रः@} Ischury. .{@-च्छ्रम्@} Sin. .{@-च्छ्रम्, कृच्छ्रेत्, कृच्छ्रत्@} {%ind.%} With great difficulty, painfully, miserably; लब्धं कृच्छ्रेण रक्ष्यते <ls>H. 1. 163</ls>.
